AboutPage.title: About Us
AboutPage.subtitle: We are ready to share our expertise and introduce the latest digital and artificial intelligence technologies for use in your organization
AboutPage.description: AKAF System Software Group, with over two decades of experience in software development, is a team of distinguished IT professionals who have become a trusted partner for factories, companies, and business centers.

intro.title: Get to Know AKAF Group
intro.paragraph1: AKAF System began its operations in 1988 in Gorgan, a city in Golestan Province, Iran, focusing on developing computer software in the fields of accounting and management. After successfully developing and launching several software products and serving dozens of satisfied customers, the company was officially established as "Arman Kabir Andisheh Forouzan" with registration number 7346.
intro.paragraph2: In 2003, the company was recognized as the top software design company in Iran and received the Golden Medal of IT Elites. This achievement is a testament to the quality and innovation of AKAF System's products and services.
intro.paragraph3: Currently, AKAF System has become a trusted and reputable partner for factories, companies, and business centers across the country by designing and developing dozens of specialized software, websites, and practical applications.
intro.paragraph4: In line with expanding its international activities and after a successful experience in Turkey, AKAF System decided to expand its operations in the Persian Gulf countries. Accordingly, in 2023, by establishing a new office in Muscat, the capital of Oman, under the name "AKAF Investment & Integrated Projects," the company expanded its international activities in the fields of industrial robot production, AI-based software, and business application development.

FAQ.title: Frequently asked questions
FAQ.subtitle: Purchase and payment information before you start

items.question: Is the digital menu helpful for my business?
items.answer: Absolutely. The AKAF digital menu is built for restaurants and cafés to increase sales, reduce printing costs, and deliver a modern guest experience.

items.question: After payment, how long does setup take?
items.answer: Depending on the package, setup usually takes 72 hours to one week. Our team captures your menu, uploads every item, and performs full testing before launch.

items.question: What happens right after I purchase the software?
items.answer: Our specialists contact you, collect all required information, and if needed schedule an on-site visit to shoot photos, videos, and content so your panel is perfectly configured.

items.question: Do you handle photographing the menu items?
items.answer: Yes. The AKAF media crew can produce professional photos and videos of your dishes, drinks, and venue to showcase inside the digital menu.

items.question: How do I report an issue or request support?
items.answer: Submit a ticket through the support portal, reach us via WhatsApp, phone, or email, and our success team will respond immediately. Support is included in every plan.

items.question: Can I pay monthly?
items.answer: Yes. All plans can be billed monthly or annually, and you always receive full platform access plus support.

items.question: Do I get a discount for annual payments?
items.answer: Paying for a full year upfront lowers the effective monthly rate and unlocks bonus services, gifts, and exclusive feature updates.

items.question: Is there an extra fee for support?
items.answer: No. Premium support is bundled with every subscription, so you never pay anything additional for assistance.

items.question: Which payment methods are available?
items.answer: You can pay via bank transfer, direct deposit, card-to-card payments, or our secure online gateways connected to AKAF corporate accounts.

items.question: Can I enable online payments inside the menu?
items.answer: Yes. For Oman and GCC customers we activate bank gateways and Thawani so guests can pay online and funds settle straight into your account.

items.question: Do you offer refunds?
items.answer: You may request a refund within 24 hours of payment. After content production and gateway activation begin, the fee becomes non-refundable.

items.question: How do I receive invoices or contracts?
items.answer: Once your order is confirmed we issue a digital contract and official invoice instantly, and we can mail a printed copy if needed.
